name: seo-collection-page-audit
summary: Audit ecommerce collection/category pages for intent, assortment relevance, information gain, unique value, pagination, filters, and template risk.
inputs: approved collection, product, keyword, SERP, crawl, analytics, link, filter, Brand, and merchandising evidence
external_reads: approved provider, page, analytics, catalog, and first-party evidence
approval_gates: external_read: ask before live provider, page, analytics, or catalog reads
provider_data: paid or credentialed calls require approval
vault_write: save only to resolved context
external_mutation: pages, filters, canonicals, URLs, CMS, code, and production changes are out of scope
done_when: catalog, hierarchy, template, source tiers, information gain, risks, owners, and rechecks are explicit
no product, assortment, price, inventory, or query demand is invented
scaled recommendations have information-gain and business-purpose evidence
seo-quality-gate passes or is explicitly deferred
verification: verify unavailable sources produced no fabricated assortment or demand
verify no page, filter, canonical, URL, CMS, code, or production mutation occurred
verify changed artifact and review registration when applicable
